criteria.statement: The root is one Git repository
The original AppleBooks history remains reachable and its imported tree is unchanged
criteria.evidence_command: NESTED_HEAD=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("agent-system/work/P0/evidence/preflight.json"))["nested_head"])') && git merge-base --is-ancestor "$NESTED_HEAD" HEAD && test "$(git rev-parse "$NESTED_HEAD^{tree}")" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD:AppleBooks)"

criteria.statement: No nested Git repository remains active, including directory, file, or gitlink markers
criteria.evidence_command: python3 -c "import os,subprocess,sys; root=os.path.realpath('.'); found=[]; [found.append(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(d,'.git'),root)) for d,ds,fs in os.walk(root) if d != root and '.git' in ds]; [found.append(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(d,'.git'),root)) for d,ds,fs in os.walk(root) if d != root and '.git' in fs]; p=subprocess.run(['git','ls-files','--stage'],capture_output=True,text=True); found += [line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('160000 ')]; print('\n'.join(sorted(found))); sys.exit(1 if found else 0)"

criteria.statement: Every valid example validates and every static must-fail fixture is rejected
criteria.evidence_command: for f in agent-system/examples/valid/*.json; do python3 -m agentctl validate "$f" >/dev/null || exit 1; done; for f in agent-system/examples/invalid/static/*.json; do if python3 -m agentctl validate "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 1; fi; done
